name: Lets Cube Sigua 2023
information:
Let’s Cube Sigua 2023 es una competencia que se realizara a 30 minutos de la capital colonial de Honduras, siendo apoyada por la alcaldia municipal de Siguatepeque. Sera un evento abierto a competidores de cualquier nacionalidad.

__________________________________________________________________________________________________________________

Let's Cube Sigua 2023 is a competition that will take place 30 minutes from the colonial capital of Honduras, being supported by the municipal mayor of Siguatepeque. It will be an event open to competitors of any nationality.
